parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity records for dapagliflozin (CHEMBL429910) and its salt forms against sodium/glucose cotransporter 2 (CHEMBL3884). Define the compound set from the parent dapagliflozin through molecule_hierarchy to include all related salts. Join through the FAQ provenance path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Include compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter for target CHEMBL3884 and standard_type IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; preserve all activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
